scope: Public GTA reference library, organized by task and method; no private product inventory
return_policy: Every originating task returns committed public-safe methods, results and useful failures.

topics.name: CLEO scripting
topics.validation_focus: Choose the exact game/CLEO profile, inspect supported opcodes, validate and compile; report gameplay separately.

topics.name: Native plugins and engine behavior
topics.validation_focus: Record executable hash/architecture, SDK pin, layouts, calling conventions and signature evidence before native hooks.

topics.name: Reverse engineering and reconstruction
topics.validation_focus: Use exact input hashes and bounded xrefs/types/assembly; distinguish observed evidence from inferred reconstruction.

topics.name: World, model and traffic authoring
topics.validation_focus: Check supported game/file formats, use permitted fixtures and record import/edit/export roundtrip behavior.

topics.name: Multiplayer and server research
topics.validation_focus: Match exact client/server revisions; separate byte-matching claims, functional behavior and documentation; use synthetic data.

topics.name: Graphics, navigation and radar
topics.validation_focus: Check exact target, prerequisites and mod combinations; report exercised visual/runtime scenarios and measurements.
